lesson.subtitle: Lesson 8 -- The New Office
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 8 -- The New Office
lesson.grammar_point: adjectives with to be (big, small, new, quiet) + very
phases: It Is Big, It Is New

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, this is Diane. I am in the new office now, and I send you a photo. The building is very big, but our floor is small. It is quiet here, and that is good for calls. There are eight desks and one meeting room. The window is big and the view is the water. I think you are going to like it. Talk to you soon.

Hi Ricardo, Paul here. One more thing about Miami. The beach is ten minutes from the office by car, and it is free. On Friday many people go there after work. It is not expensive to live near the office, but the traffic is bad at six. My advice: live near the water, not near the highway. See you soon.

extra_audio.text: The new office is in Miami. The building is very big and modern. Our floor is small and quiet. The beach is near, ten minutes by car. Your desk is near the window.
